summary: The limits policy keeps its last good config when the config file is missing or invalid, instead of reading a missing file as the policy being off

replay.detail: No claim replay or stored history changes.

schema.detail: No database schema, version or stored data changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordination changes; no coordinated upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or config contract change.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption or startup migration is required. A daemon that cannot read its config file on a limits pass logs the reason once and keeps the policy it had.

recovery.detail: Only the reload of the limits config changes; reverting restores reading a missing file as the defaults.
